title: •Ability, Ability, Ability
caption: •Ability, Ability, Ability (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. You may not play Imperial Barrier. Senators are deploy +2. Whenever you initiate a battle, may retrieve your topmost non-{lightsaber}, non-{maintenance} character. May place the top card of your Reserve Deck in Lost Pile to place a combat card in owner’s Lost Pile. {alter}
lore: “Ben. . . Ben, please! Ben. . . Leia! Hear me. Leia!”

notes: Unique. Dark counterpart of vs6/06 Civil Disorder; transcribed the same way. Two inline icons in 'non-[black square, green blade], non-[gold spoked wheel] character' → {lightsaber} and {maintenance} per this run's instructions (the stub expands them as 'non-warrior, non-pilot'). Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}; curly apostrophe in owner’s. The wiki's default 'Ability, Ability, Ability' page is the printed archive face (card_uid 5_110o; 'Ability, Ability, Ability (Original)' is the same face); the 745 px CC-D-abilityabilityability.gif is the D-E1 PC Errata face (game text 'At the end of opponent's deploy phase…') — downloaded to src/vs6/27-CC-D-abilityabilityability.gif for art only, the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from both scans: curly double quotes, and 'Hear me. Leia!' — a period after 'me' on both the 350 and 745 faces (wiki has a comma); spaced ellipses 'Ben. . .' as on the card. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
